positioning.title: Agentic CX Platform Architect
positioning.summary: Few people combine 20 years of contact-center depth, a live enterprise Amazon Connect migration, and hands-on GenAI platform work in a regulated payer. Position yourself as the person who takes agentic AI from pilot to governed production in the contact center, not as a generic AI engineer.
proofPoints: Amazon Connect migration across 50+ lines of business
GenAI Centre of Excellence on AWS Bedrock and AgentCore
Production guardrails, evals and audit design for PHI workloads
Published reference architectures and a reusable MCP server template

phases.name: Now to January 2027
phases.theme: Quick, free credentials and a visible artifact
goals: Complete AWS Agentic AI Demonstrated and Amazon Connect AI Fundamentals (both free)
Finish the Strands harness course and one Anthropic Academy course on MCP or Bedrock
Book the AWS AI Business Strategist beta (USD 50) before 15 Feb 2027 if CoE leadership is a goal
Publish this hub and the playbook; share one LinkedIn write-up on agentic contact-center architecture

phases.name: February to April 2027
goals: Study for and pass AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional (AIP-C01)
Ship Blueprint A pilot on one Connect LOB and record measured outcomes
Build an internal MCP server template on the 2026-07-28 spec and open-source a sanitized version

phases.name: May to August 2027
goals: Onboard a second LOB through the paved-road kit
Speak at an AWS Community Day or user group on governed agents in contact centers
Optional: Claude Certified Architect – Foundations if partner access is available

phases.name: September to December 2027
goals: Optional: AWS Solutions Architect – Professional (new version) if not already held
Mentor 3–5 engineers through AIP-C01; publish a CoE operating-model case study
Refresh this roadmap from the weekly updates log

weeklyHabits: Monday: read this hub's new weekly update (10 minutes)
Two evenings: one course module or one hands-on lab
Friday: write 5 lines on what you learned and applied at work
